shots.prompt: Wide shot inside a small cinema lobby in the evening: a row of blank framed posters on a deep green wall, warm brass lamps, a wooden bench. Selin, a woman of 22 with long dark hair in an olive-green coat, stands in front of the posters, arms crossed, thinking; Deniz, a man of 24 with short dark hair, round glasses and a denim jacket, stands beside her, hands in his pockets. Vertical composition. Vertical composition.
